A few words worth knowing

Whole
The complete amount used as the reference.
Numerator
The number of selected equal parts.
Denominator
The number of equal parts making one whole.
Equivalent
Describing the same amount, even with different-sized pieces.
Decimal point
The mark separating whole-number places from tenths, hundredths and smaller places.
